captions.summary: [source_response] A_v (kinematic proxy, O(beta), ell=1) and Omega_tilt (physical tilt, O(beta), ell=1) are distinct types with no auto-bridge; the kinematic quadrupole enters at O(beta^2), ell=2, and is removed from the shear reading by the synthetic deprojection. Analytic response rank 2 (the PR-127 frozen map, kernel = the W2/DeltaOmega_k joint null); under a Sigma2/Omega_tilt window collinearity the observed rank drops to 1 and the aligned-axis rank-1 exception is surfaced. Pre-solver discrimination only; no scalar family/geometry measurement.
